description: Search the location's own published policies, FAQ entries and info pages (privacy, terms, returns, delivery, cookies, help articles) plus, when the owner allows it, their internal knowledge base. Returns short snippets with a link to the source. Use it for policy/help questions instead of guessing; use get_store_info when you need structured numbers.

limit.description: How many snippets to return (1–10, default 5)

query.description: The guest question, in any language

name: search_policies_and_faqs
